title: Don't waste food
notes: Contrast short. The phone in the opening plays OUR clip (series character chocmilk-max doing an over-the-top ice cream, with an unbranded TikTok-style UI), composited onto a green screen; the original's third-party TikTok is not reproduced. The reacting creator is series character chocmilk-chill. The original's four close-ups of distressed children are replaced by dignified stand-ins without children (adult hands sharing one chocolate square, an empty cup, an almost empty tin bowl, one bread roll torn into pieces). Ice-cream tubs and packaging are unbranded. Sora audio.
style: One continuous unedited take: no cuts, no jump cuts, no zooms. Realistic, natural light, crisp focus, no on-screen text, no logos or brand names.

sets.P: A light-skinned adult hand holds a black smartphone in a bright yellow case upright and steady, about 35 cm in front of the camera, over a light oak desk with a black charging cable; the phone fills the middle 60% of the frame width; daylight, shallow depth of field.
sets.K: Person B in a dim modern kitchen at night lit by violet-blue LED strip light along the ceiling and walls, sitting behind a light oak table; static frontal camera at table height.

phone.desc: a black smartphone in a bright yellow case

tubs.desc: two large white rectangular two-litre plastic ice-cream tubs with a light-blue label band and no text

bowl.desc: a large clear glass mixing bowl, empty

icecream.desc: a large clear glass bowl and one white two-litre tub of vanilla ice cream with a red lid and no text

choc.desc: one small square of milk chocolate

cup.desc: an empty, slightly crumpled clear plastic cup

tin.desc: a dented white enamel tin bowl with a thin blue rim, empty except for a few grains of rice

D1.desc: close-up on a worn patterned cotton cloth spread on dusty ground, warm late-afternoon light, documentary photography style, shallow depth of field
D1.layout: The small chocolate square lies in the centre of the cloth (45-60% of the frame height); the frame is otherwise empty (hands will enter).

D2.desc: close-up against a soft out-of-focus background of a dusty courtyard and a weathered wall, soft daylight, documentary photography style
D2.layout: The empty plastic cup stands alone on a rough wooden crate in the centre of the frame (40-65% height).

D3.desc: close-up on dry cracked earth, warm low sun, documentary photography style, shallow depth of field
D3.layout: The tin bowl sits in the centre of the frame (45-70% height), seen slightly from above so the few grains inside are visible.

D4.desc: close-up on a rough wooden table outdoors in warm late-afternoon light, documentary photography style
D4.layout: The single bread roll lies in the centre of the table (45-60% height); the rest of the table is empty (hands will enter).

performances.prompt: The hand holds the phone completely still for the whole clip, barely moving. the phone screen is lit with a perfectly flat, uniform, pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) image from edge to edge: no interface, no reflections, no glare.

He stands behind a speckled granite kitchen counter in his warm kitchen; on the counter there is only a large clear glass bowl (remove the giant jar, the pot, the steel bowl and the milk jugs). 0-3 s: he lifts the whole tub of vanilla ice cream and dumps it upside down into the bowl, screaming with joy. 3-7 s: he squeezes a huge stream of chocolate sauce all over the ice cream. 7-12 s: he sprays a mountain of whipped cream on top and laughs into the camera.

He now wears a plain mustard-yellow T-shirt. The table is now bare except one large empty clear glass mixing bowl in front of him (remove the glass, the bottle, the box, the carton and the frother). 0-1 s: he looks into the camera. 1-6 s: he holds the two ice-cream tubs upside down over the bowl and shakes them; nothing comes out because the ice cream is frozen solid; he grins. 6-8 s: he lowers the tubs onto the table either side of the bowl and stops smiling. 8-12 s: he looks into the camera seriously and slowly wags his index finger 'no'.

shots.prompt: Two weathered adult hands (only the hands and wrists) enter, break the chocolate square in half, and one hand slowly offers one half toward the camera. Gentle, respectful, documentary feel.
A weathered adult hand (only the hand and wrist) enters, picks up the empty plastic cup and slowly holds it up to the light, turning it; it is empty. Documentary feel.
A weathered adult hand (only the hand and wrist) enters and slowly tilts the tin bowl toward the camera, showing it is empty except for a few grains of rice. Documentary feel.
Several weathered adult hands (only hands and wrists) reach in and each carefully tears a small piece from the single bread roll, sharing it between many people. Documentary feel.
